_doc: The ONLY definition of the team rates (#1153). Each formula is scale * (num) / (den), num and den being linear combinations of counters; net_rating is a difference. Python (src/stats/formulas.py), the browser (frontend/src/lib/formulas.ts) and the Mongo pipelines (formulas.mongo_expression) read it; tests/formulas/vector.json (textbook expressions, independent of this file) checks all three. Counters: points, points_against, fg2m, fg2a, fg3m, fg3a, fta, ast, stl, blk, tov, orb, drb, opp_orb, opp_drb (the rival's rebounds), poss and opp_poss (the REAL possessions of the team and of its rival, #1154). The cost of a free throw (0.44) is the tracker's (live_core.four_factors.FT_POSSESSION_COST).
